component_hierarchy.name: Header
component_hierarchy.description: Sticky top bar with PENDING™ logo, nav links (SCAMS, SYSTEM, INDIA, CORPORATE, LIMITED DROPS, LOOKBOOK, ARCHIVE), search trigger, wishlist counter, cart trigger with live count badge, and top scrolling announcement ribbon.

component_hierarchy.name: HeroSection
component_hierarchy.description: Massive editorial hero featuring bold 'QUESTION EVERYTHING.' typographic statement, satirical subtitle, primary CTAs [SHOP THE DROP] and [EXPLORE THE SYSTEM], high-impact streetwear photo, and live system diagnostics badge.

component_hierarchy.name: LiveDropSection
component_hierarchy.description: 4-item showcase grid for live drop items (SCAM DETECTED™, SYSTEM ERROR 404, UNDER PROCESS, TRUST THE PROCESS) with hover image flip, quick add drawer trigger, low stock meter, and limited badges.

component_hierarchy.name: CategorySystemNav
component_hierarchy.description: Interactive category matrix for SCAMS, SYSTEM, INDIA, CORPORATE, LIMITED DROPS with distinct satirical visual cards, micro-interactions, and direct filter routing.

component_hierarchy.name: PendingOSTerminal
component_hierarchy.description: Interactive retro-futuristic PENDING OS v1.0 console with real-time typewriter diagnostics evaluating Accountability, Meetings, Jugaad, Indian Bureaucracy, and Traffic with user interaction buttons.

component_hierarchy.name: EditorialLookbookStrip
component_hierarchy.description: Immersive visual spread showcasing DROP 001 — WEAR THE CHAOS with street-level fashion imagery and brutalist layout.

component_hierarchy.name: ManifestoSection
component_hierarchy.description: High-contrast full-width black section with 'WE DON'T MAKE CLOTHES FOR EVERYONE.' manifesto, core pillars, and button to full manifesto page.

component_hierarchy.name: ArchiveSection
component_hierarchy.description: Brutalist archived system records for drops 001-004 marked SOLD OUT with historical timestamps.

component_hierarchy.name: NewsletterSection
component_hierarchy.description: 'GET NOTIFIED BEFORE IT'S GONE.' newsletter signup box with instant satirical toast feedback.

component_hierarchy.name: CartDrawer
component_hierarchy.description: Slide-over cart sheet with dynamic item quantities, size/color details, free-shipping threshold bar (₹1,999 target), discount code mock ('JUGAAD10'), subtotal calculation in INR (₹), and proceed to checkout trigger.

component_hierarchy.name: SearchOverlay
component_hierarchy.description: Instant keyboard-accessible search modal with hot-key support ('/'), live keyword filtering, instant thumbnail results, and suggested queries ('Scam', 'Corporate', 'Error 404', 'Oversized Tee').

component_hierarchy.name: ProductCard
component_hierarchy.description: Standardized streetwear product card with secondary image hover reveal, stock status badge, quick-add popover, wishlist toggle, and formatted INR pricing.

component_hierarchy.name: QuickAddModal
component_hierarchy.description: Fast size & color picker dialog triggered right from catalog cards without navigating away.

component_hierarchy.name: Footer
component_hierarchy.description: Raw industrial footer with giant PENDING™ watermark typography, Indian manufacturing badge (MADE IN INDIA 2026), newsletter, customer service links, and satiric disclaimer.

accessibility.data_testids: Strict role-based kebab-case testing attributes on every interactable
accessibility.keyboard_navigation: Full focus-visible styling with ring-2 ring-[#E52A1B] or ring-[#D9FF32]
accessibility.reduced_motion: Supports prefers-reduced-motion by bypassing transform animations

instructions_to_main_agent: Template is farm-ts: FastAPI backend at backend/ (proxy at /api), Vite + React 19 frontend at frontend/src/.
Use INR currency format (e.g., ₹1,799, ₹1,999) with Indian numbering conventions.
Persist cart and wishlist in browser localStorage with demo state hydrated from the 15 mock products.

Implement rich interactive features: Cart drawer with free shipping progress bar (target ₹1,999), instant search modal with keyboard shortcut '/' and live debounced results, quick size select popup, lookbook viewer with image inspection, interactive PENDING OS v1.0 diagnostic simulator with real-time logging, and interactive checkout mock with UPI/QR tabs and order confirmation invoice.

Ensure all interactive items have rigorous data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='add-to-bag-button', data-testid='cart-drawer-toggle', data-testid='search-input', data-testid='checkout-button', data-testid='filter-category-scams').
Maintain the uncompromising high-fashion streetwear feel: sharp borders, neo-brutalist grids, aggressive typography, witty satire copy on Indian systems, scams, HR culture, and bureaucracy.
